_doc: Pearl object_event movement_type -> Black 2 zone NPC "move" (a/1/2/6 ZoneNPC.moveCode). Names: pokeplatinum generated/movement_types.txt (index = value; Pearl numbering checked against 349 matched Platinum event files: every used value agrees, e.g. Twinleaf 389: 3 = WANDER_AROUND, 2 = LOOK_AROUND, 15 = LOOK_SOUTH). Black 2 codes: ov036 ACTOR_MOVE_CODE_FUNCTION_TABLES 0x021cc990 and the direction lists at 0x021cbc70, read from the vanilla ov036.bin (PearlB2 external/pokebw2/extract/b2_us), HoennB2 notes/NPC_MOVEMENT.md. Gen 5 kept Gen 4's numbering: every look list and walk route agrees with the Platinum name except Black 2 code 26 (walks 25's W-E-S-N route), which Pearl does not use. Range: movement_range_x -> areaw, movement_range_z -> areah unchanged (both games: spawn +- range, 0 = no movement on that axis, -1/0xFFFF = no limit; pokeplatinum map_object_move.c MapObject_IsOutOfRange; Pearl has no -1). "uses" = objects; "trainers" = of them with trainer_type != 0.

0.note: stand facing the dir field (Black 2 0 = empty init/update). Most are things: 591 Rock Smash rocks, 262 balls, signs, boulders, trees

5.note: wander inside spawn +- areaw/areah (3 all ways, 4 N-S, 5 W-E); copy the ranges

16.note: face one way (= code 0 + that dir); dir field = W

17.note: face one way (= code 0 + that dir); dir field = E

50.note: follow the partner trainer (3 Pearl double pairs: Route 209, Route 210 North, Victory Road B1F: the 5000+id leader walks a route, the 3000+id partner follows). Black 2 50 = trainer pair partner (own init 0x02192ca9); no vanilla zone NPC uses it, so untested

51.note: hidden under snow, jumps out (Route 217). Black 2 has no snow hide: 51/54 = grass (init type 0), 52/53 = soil mound (type 1), 85 = leaf pile (type 2) (init immediates at 0x02192fd4..0x02193004); a mound is the nearest shape. Pearl gives these trainer_type 2 (view all directions) = Black 2 evtype 2, as Black 2's own hidden trainers

52.note: hidden under sand (Route 228) -> soil mound (type 1). Pearl gives these trainer_type 2 (view all directions) = Black 2 evtype 2, as Black 2's own hidden trainers

53.note: hidden under a rock (Routes 210N, 211) -> soil mound (type 1). Pearl gives these trainer_type 2 (view all directions) = Black 2 evtype 2, as Black 2's own hidden trainers

54.note: hidden in grass (Route 210S) -> grass (type 0), exact; Black 2's own: 4 uses, evtype 2. Pearl gives these trainer_type 2 (view all directions) = Black 2 evtype 2, as Black 2's own hidden trainers

dirs._doc: Pearl initial_dir -> Black 2 dir: identical (pokeplatinum constants/map_object.h DIR_NORTH 0, SOUTH 1, WEST 2, EAST 3; pokebw2 constants/directions.h DIR_UP 0, DOWN 1, LEFT 2, RIGHT 3). Pearl uses only 0-3.

range.note: unchanged; -1 (0xFFFF) = no limit in both, 0 = fixed on that axis

trainer_type_to_evtype._doc: Pearl trainer_type -> Black 2 ZoneNPC.evType. Gen 4 names: pokeplatinum generated/trainer_types.txt. Black 2 sight: event_trainer_eye.c func_ov036_021a643c -> fldmmdl.c func_ov012_02168024 maps evType 4-8, 11-13 to 1 (look along the facing), 2 = all 4 ways; Gen 4 trainer_encounter.c GetTrainerType does the same for 4-8.

1.note: p0 = data[0] = sight range (Black 2 trainers: p0 0-7)

3.note: only on 6 item balls (Routes 203, 205S), not trainers; Black 2 item balls are evtype 0

7.note: Black 2 evtype 7: sight like 1, walker handler = the default one (ACTOR_EVENTTYPE_FUNCS[7]); Black 2 itself has 1 such trainer
